There is no shower room. There is no water

The place was quiet and clean—perfect if you just need somewhere to spend the night. The location was great, and the price too (I got room 5 for only 2000 DA). There was no water in the room—the faucet wasn’t working—but there were some filled bottles to use instead, which was kind of inconvenient. I didn’t really care though since I only went there to sleep. Can’t really complain about the service since there basically wasn’t any lol, but overall it definitely deserves a 4-star rating.
